verdict.rationale: Warp's homepage describes a built-in Warp Agent that takes on onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits tasks. It asks the user when a decision is theirs and records every action it takes, which is the core of delegating tasks to an in-product assistant. The support rests on a single marketing claim with no detailed docs. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how tasks are assigned to the agent and what it can do, documented limits or approval controls beyond the one-line claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Warp Agent takes onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits. It asks when a decision is yours, and records every action it takes.
